author: Kimi fresh L1
lowestAxisObligation: Both owned axes sit on the 10/10 saturation line, so the lowest-axis rule is met by construction: C1 works operability and C2 works freshness, one axis each.

claims.title: A wave-evidence ledger that re-derives the round's own seat accounting, route deviations and time accounting from committed bytes
claims.before: 0 of 3 at the base 007d66e (no ledger instrument, no route receipts, no time accounting)
claims.after: 3 of 3 at the measured commit (the settlement, the route receipts, the time-accounting artifact and the LOG figure are all committed)

conditions.L1: seat accounting: the committed seat-report count under .ufo/waves/round-51/w1/ equals the settlement's reports_written, the settlement's spawn equals the payload's seat count, and every seat marked as having a report has exactly one committed report file
conditions.L2: route receipts: every route the wave used has a committed probe receipt with an integer HTTP status, a failing receipt carries a body excerpt and is not used by a role, and every failing receipt is recorded as a deviation in the route map
conditions.L3: time accounting: the aggregate seat seconds, the dead-seat seconds and the wave wall clock are re-derivable from the committed settlement and wave-timing bytes, the committed time-accounting artifact carries the same figures, LOG.md names the wall-clock figure, and every dead seat's duration matches its recorded reason

claims.doNothingControl: the base revision 007d66e scores 0 of 3; the counter reads committed bytes only
claims.killRule: a miss on any of L1, L2 or L3 is an honest stop for C1 and is reported as such

claims.kind: sourced learning claim (assimilation of one theme)
claims.title: Google's canonical selection and crawler identity enter held ground as two source-backed entries on rows S262 and S263, re-grounded in this round
claims.before: 0 of 8 at the base 007d66e (neither entry, neither row, no retained source, no pre-append mirror)
claims.after: 8 of 8 at the measured commit (two rows appended, two entries landed, both Gate quotes raw in the retained bodies, the mirror census-validated with --file before the append)

conditions.C1: both admitted entries exist at their repo-relative paths
conditions.C2: each entry cites its own row id below its 8-line metadata header
conditions.C3: each registry row has 11 cells, no literal or escaped pipe, status mined, the round's opened date and a normalized recheck
conditions.C4: each row's used-by lists exactly the admitted entry that cites it
conditions.C5: each lesson Gate quote is 6 to 25 words and an exact raw substring of the retained body
conditions.C6: each retained body's sha256 equals its receipt's sha256 and its receipt URL is the registry row's URL
conditions.C7: the pre-append census receipt names --file and the mirror path and not --root, its exit is 0 and its stdout carries no E03 and no E04
conditions.C8: the pre-append mirror commit is a strict ancestor of the measured revision, the mirror's registry carries none of the adopted ids and the measured revision's registry carries all of them

claims.doNothingControl: the base revision 007d66e scores 0 of 8; the counter reads committed bytes only
claims.killRule: a miss on any of C1..C8 is an honest stop for C2 and is reported as such

separability: C1's counter reads only the wave evidence (settlement, payload, route map, probe receipts, timing, time accounting, LOG.md); C2's counter reads only the registry, the two entries, the lesson, the retained bodies and the pre-append mirror. Neither counter reads the other's inputs, so either claim verifies with the other unlanded.
theme: one theme: what the engine does with a publisher's canonical declaration and with its own crawler identity — the selection half of the canonical signal and the identity half of the crawl signal

routedDefectsAddressed.r50-1: the seat-report count is now a committed, re-derivable ledger condition (L1) instead of prose
routedDefectsAddressed.r50-2: the route substitutions now carry committed probe receipts with an HTTP status and a body excerpt (L2)
routedDefectsAddressed.r50-3: the aggregate round-overrun figure is now derived from committed bytes and named in LOG.md (L3)
routedDefectsAddressed.r50-4: the ten inherited paths stay untouched and uncommitted
